GlobalSecondaryIndexes._comment: Dashboard rollups: every budget state of a given scope type in a window.
Sparse index over unsettled reservations, for the stale-reservation sweeper. Entries are removed on settlement, so it only ever holds outstanding work.

TimeToLiveSpecification._comment: Housekeeping only. TTL never decides whether a request is authorised -- budget windows are addressed by key, so a new period begins on the stroke of the boundary rather than when DynamoDB gets around to deleting the old item.
